description: Use this tool whenever a user asks how much to convert from a Traditional/Rollover IRA to a Roth IRA, how to avoid crossing the next federal tax bracket or Medicare IRMAA cliff, how the IRC Sec. 408(d)(2) Pro-Rata rule affects a Backdoor Roth IRA, or how to model a $72,000 Mega Backdoor Roth 401(k) conversion.

age.description: Current age of the taxpayer (triggers Medicare IRMAA lookback at 63+ and OBBBA Senior Deduction at 65+).

convertAmount.description: Proposed dollar amount in USD to convert to a Roth IRA this year.

filing.description: Federal tax filing status (single, mfj, mfs, or hoh).

income.description: Baseline household income (MAGI) in USD before the Roth conversion.

iraBasis.description: Existing non-deductible after-tax basis in Traditional IRAs reported on IRS Form 8606 in USD.

pretaxIra.description: Total pre-tax balance across all Traditional, Rollover, SEP, and SIMPLE IRAs in USD.

name: calculate_roth_conversion
title: Calculate Roth Conversion Tax Cost, Backdoor Roth Pro-Rata & IRMAA / Bracket Cliff Ceilings
